Six months of us ♥

Happy 6th monthsary to the girl who owns my heart, my baby mommy It feels like just yesterday we started this relationship, and yet here we are six whole months, and every single one of them has been meaningful because you were in it. I was just thinking about everything we've been through already, the late night calls that lasted until we fell asleep, the silly jokes only we understand, the misunderstandings that taught us how to listen better, and even those quiet moments where we didn't need to say anything at all because just knowing the other was there was enough. They say you don't choose who you fall in love with, and honestly? I'm so glad it chose me to love you. You've become more than just someone I date. You're my best friend. You're the first thought I have when I wake up and the last voice I want to hear before I close my eyes. When my day is messy or stressful, just seeing your name on my phone makes everything feel a little lighter. When I feel far away or unsure, you're the one who feels like home, even from miles apart. I know I'm not perfect. I know sometimes I overthink, sometimes I worry too much, and sometimes I don't always say exactly the right things. We don't always see eye to eye, and there are moments when we misunderstand each other. But please believe me when I say I am learning, I am growing, and I am trying every single day to be better for you. Because you deserve someone who shows up, who listens, who stays, and who never makes you feel like you're fighting alone. If I could give you one thing in this life, I'd give you the ability to see yourself through my eyes. Only then would you realize how special you are to me. Thank you for your patience with me. Thank you for telling me what you need, even when it's hard. Thank you for letting me be the person you come to, the one you share your days with, your tired moments, your joy, and your dreams. Thank you for trusting me with your heart. I promise I'll always handle it gently. You are beautiful in ways words struggle to describe: your kindness, your laugh, your strength, the way you care about the people you love. You inspire me to be better, to dream bigger, and to cherish what truly matters. I want more months like this. I want years. I want to see you achieve your dreams, be there when things get hard, celebrate every little win with you, and grow old knowing we did it together. Whatever life throws our way, whatever challenges we face, know this: I'm right here. Through the busy days, the quiet nights, the good times and the tough ones I choose you. Today, tomorrow, and every day after that. You make my life sweeter just by being in it. Thank you for being my person. Happy 6th monthsary, Mommy. Here's to us, to everything we've shared so far, and to the beautiful future that's still waiting for us. I LOVE YOU MORE than I can ever fully say, infinitely and always. Happy 6 months, Darlingg!!💗💗
